_comment: Copy this file to project_sources.json and fill in your own projects. project_sources.json is gitignored so your project list stays local. If the file is missing, the assets feature is simply disabled (PROJECT_SOURCES = {}).
_format: source_id: {name, description, icon, type}. type is 'game' or 'app'. icon is a Lucide icon name.

my-game.name: My Game
my-game.description: A short description of your game

my-app.name: My App
my-app.description: A short description of your app
